__meta__.purpose: Disambiguate the Football-Data <-> Understat deterministic join (V23 Task 1).
__meta__.direction: Understat display name -> Football-Data display name
__meta__.derivation: Data-derived from the committed Understat corpus (backend/data/processed/v4_sources) and the Football-Data cache (backend/data/cache). Only pairs that do not already agree after accent/punctuation/common-affix normalization are listed. Re-derive, never invent: run backend/scripts/evaluate_understat_ablation.py --audit-join.
__meta__.join_key: (canonical league, kickoff date +/- 1 day, home_goals, away_goals) narrowed to a unique match by team-name agreement on BOTH sides
__meta__.note: A collision (same league, same scoreline, same day) is resolved by requiring both teams to match; an entry here is needed only where a club's two sources spell its name differently.
